about.title:
From “could this work?”
to “let’s find out.”
about.start: Built for curious makers working with Raspberry Pi 3B and 4B sensor circuits. Create an account, choose an example, adjust its values, and run a simulation.
about.next: Next on the bench: AI-assisted design conversations, saved projects, and guided iteration. Those are planned—not features we pretend are finished.
safety.note: Simulation is a thinking tool, not hardware approval. Examples use generic or ideal models. Passing a check does not verify component ratings, real-world wiring, or Raspberry Pi safety.
privacy.analytics: We use self-hosted Umami to count landing-page visits without analytics cookies. Account IDs and URL query strings are not sent; Do Not Track is respected.
